key.name: other-apps-keybinding
key.description: Every window on the current monitor + current workspace, all apps. TOML key [keys].other_apps. Default chord "alt+tab" -> "<Alt>Tab".

key.name: current-app-keybinding
key.description: Every window of the active app, gathered from all workspaces + all monitors. TOML key [keys].current_app. Default chord "alt+`" -> "<Alt>grave".

key.name: everything-keybinding
key.description: Every window, all apps/workspaces/monitors. TOML key [keys].everything. Default chord "ctrl+alt+tab" -> "<Primary><Alt>Tab". Note: this default collides with GNOME's built-in switch-group binding, which ZenTab supersedes via setCustomKeybindingHandler rather than this private key (see keybinding.ts) — this key only fires if the resolved chord does NOT match a built-in ZenTab already overrides.
